items.statement: The investigation explicitly formulates competing hypotheses and validates chemically distinct pathway candidates with object-specific TS/connectivity evidence and search coverage.
items.expected: Hypotheses, candidates, validation and stopping/coverage are reported for both pathways.

items.statement: The two anomeric radical-addition pathways have distinguishable activation free energies and one pathway is lower.
items.expected: A common-reference barrier comparison and direction are reported.

items.statement: The source computational result is consistent with α-selective radical addition, with reported barriers 7.3 and 11.2 kcal/mol and a 3.9 kcal/mol difference.
items.expected: The independent result is compared with this source conclusion without assuming it publicly.
